audience.value: Web developers familiar with basic HTTP; assume no prior real-time networking expertise.

communication_intent.value: Use two illustrated forum pain points to introduce Polling, Long Polling, SSE and WebSocket. Explain the methods practically, then share concise best practices and trade-offs. Finish with Demo & Q&A. Exclude SignalR and Webhooks.

audience_outcome.value: Understand the four methods, distinguish server-to-client updates from two-way messaging, and recognize reconnect, persistence and authorization responsibilities.

core_message.value: Choose the communication method that fits the interaction; fast updates still need reliable application design.

delivery_context.value: Live presenter-led technical talk. All slide text in English, spoken delivery and speaker notes in Vietnamese. Diagram-led, minimal words, simple clear illustrations. Modern, clean, consistent, professional technology/academic aesthetic.

artifact_afterlife.value: Editable PowerPoint with Vietnamese speaker notes for rehearsal and future updates. Cover and agenda, illustrated pain points, one four-method overview followed by one slide per method, visual lessons, final Demo & Q&A.
